title: Acquirer: OneSteel Ltd; Target: Adelaide Steel Processing Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: OneSteel Ltd proposes to acquire Adelaide Steel Processing.
body_sections.Market definition: The Commission did not consider it necessary to define a market in the current matter as on any definition the proposed acquisition is unlikely to substantially lessen competition.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission decided not to oppose the acquisition on the basis that OneSteel's operations are complementary to rather than competitive with Adelaide Steel Processing's operations.
